_note: Scripted troubleshooting flows for the fictional shop Thistledown Home. One question at a time, buttons only. Demo data only.

tracking.text: Let's find your parcel. Have you opened the tracking link in your dispatch email (or in My orders)?

find-email.text: No problem. Sign in and open My orders: every order shows its courier tracking link there. Can you see it now?

delivered.text: Couriers often leave parcels in a safe place or with a neighbour. Please check around your door, with neighbours and for a card from the courier.

on-its-way.text: It's still moving, which is a good sign. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days, plus 2 for the Highlands, islands and Northern Ireland. Is it within that time?

message.text: Let's get you back in. What happens when you try to sign in?

options.label: It says my account is locked

locked.text: After 5 wrong tries the account locks for 15 minutes. Resetting your password unlocks it straight away. Shall we do that?

reset.text: On the sign-in page press Forgot password and enter the email address on your account. Did the reset email arrive?

spam.text: Please check your spam or junk folder. If it isn't there, request a new link: only the newest one works. Has it arrived now?

link.text: Open the link within 30 minutes and choose a new password. Were you able to sign in?

details.text: Sorry about that. First, are the card number, expiry date and security code all correct?

postcode.text: Does the billing postcode match the one your bank holds for the card?

bank-app.text: Many banks ask you to approve the payment in their app. Keep the app open while you pay, then try again. Did it go through?

another-way.text: Try another card or PayPal. We never see your full card details, so only your bank can say why it declined. Did another way work?
